title: IMPORTED SOP SOURCE-OF-TRUTH REVIEW
prompt: Review an existing restaurant SOP import batch before saving drafts. Sources: [files, versions, stations, authors]. Match each imported procedure to an existing controlled SOP, identify duplicates, ambiguous titles and untrusted extraction. Return a review queue with keep, compare, replace-draft or reject options; never publish an import automatically.
manager_check: Confirm ownership and approved status from source records, not filenames.

title: SOP WORD OR PDF EXTRACTION VALIDATION
prompt: Compare extracted steps against the uploaded SOP document: [original text or file and extracted text]. Find dropped warnings, shifted numbering, missing tables, ambiguous temperatures, units or responsibilities. Produce a correction queue for manager review and refuse to certify an extraction on appearance alone.
manager_check: An imported PDF image or imperfect OCR does not become a verified procedure.

title: SOP REVISION ARCHIVE COMPLETENESS
prompt: Audit a revised SOP's record: [old version, new version, revision notes, approver, training decision]. Verify prior versions remain retrievable, new scope and effective date are clear, linked posters are identified, and any retraining checkbox belongs to the authorized reviser.
manager_check: Preserve the record of what employees were trained to do at each effective date.

title: POSTER TO SOP LINK VERIFICATION
prompt: Check whether station posters point to the correct published SOP versions. Poster IDs and QR destinations: [list]. Current SOP versions: [list]. Flag stale links, missing posters, unreadable print, misleading shorthand and unsafe exceptions; provide a correction and verification queue.
manager_check: A QR scan should open the intended current employee-accessible SOP.

title: MANAGER-ONLY SIGNAL TRIAGE
prompt: Summarize aggregate trends in SOP, poster and training activity: [counts, dates and stations]. Identify legitimate training-demand patterns, likely navigation or content gaps, and follow-up checks without assuming an individual's motives. Keep manager analytics in authorized management views and observe applicable privacy notice and access controls.
manager_check: Viewing patterns are signals to investigate, not proof of employee performance.

title: EMPLOYEE QUESTION TO CONTROLLED REVISION
prompt: Turn employee questions and error reports about an SOP into a manager review queue. Questions: [redacted list]. Approved SOP: [version]. Cluster confusing instructions, unsafe ambiguities and missing examples. Draft clarification proposals while leaving approval, re-teach decisions and publication with the authorized reviser.
manager_check: Do not teach an unapproved revision as if it were current policy.

title: STAFF TRAINING QUIZ FAIRNESS REVIEW
prompt: Evaluate a short employee SOP quiz: [approved text, questions, answer key, outcomes]. Identify questions that depend on undocumented standards, misleading distractors, language complexity or untrained procedures. Propose clearer questions and distinguish knowledge results from demonstrated ability.
manager_check: Quiz failure can expose flaws in instruction or assessment, not just the learner.

title: CROSS-STATION LEARNING PATH
prompt: Design a voluntary cross-station learning path for [roles and interested stations] using published SOPs only. Separate view/read practice, supervised demonstration, sign-off and role authorization. Plan development without exposing employee browsing analytics or granting unsupervised access to restricted tasks.
manager_check: Interest in learning is not authorization to perform a critical station task.

title: CUSTOMER BRANDING AND EDITION SEPARATION
prompt: Review an SOP, poster, food recipe or drink recipe pack before customer distribution. Sources: [files]. Detect internal restaurant names, private recipes, employee names, local PINs and other internal details. Preserve Gravity branding where intended and list customer-logo placeholders; return a release-blocking privacy checklist.
manager_check: Never ship River-only or customer-private content in the generic product.

title: BINDER PRINT SEQUENCE & VERSION CONTROL
prompt: Create a station-by-station SOP binder print plan from [approved SOP list, effective versions, revision archive, poster associations]. Produce dividers, inclusion rules, print order, QR checks and a revision reconciliation sheet, while excluding drafts and obsolete records from current-use copies.
manager_check: Printed copies must be clearly tied to controlled revisions.

title: OPEN AND CLOSE ALLOWANCE REVIEW
prompt: Evaluate labor planning for opening and closing duties. Stations: [roles]. Tasks, normal minutes and opening/closing coverage: [data]. Distinguish shift operating hours from pre-open setup and after-close completion; calculate proposal alternatives and verify labor rules and observed workload.
manager_check: Opening and closing minutes must be planned, not hidden outside scheduled hours.

title: HOURLY COVERAGE AND DEMAND GAP
prompt: Compare a proposed staff schedule with half-hour or hourly service demand: [forecast, positions, qualifications, breaks, arrivals, departures]. Highlight uncovered stations, unqualified assignments, busy-period pinch points and available alternatives for manager review.
manager_check: A full headcount does not guarantee qualified station coverage.

title: SCHEDULE RULE CONFLICT REVIEW
prompt: Check a draft schedule against availability, approved time off, role qualifications, hours limits and local break requirements: [rules and shifts]. Report collisions without silently removing employees; recommend possible repairs requiring manager authorization.
manager_check: A schedule is a proposal until the manager approves it.

title: OVERTIME AND LABOR-PERCENT SCENARIOS
prompt: Build side-by-side labor scenarios for [forecast sales, scheduled shifts, pay rates where authorized, overtime rules and labor target]. Show scheduled hours, estimated labor dollars and labor percent, overtime exposure and tradeoffs; flag missing inputs and keep compensation details limited to authorized viewers.
manager_check: Do not invent wage data or promise labor percentage from forecast alone.

title: SCHEDULE CHANGE HISTORY RECONCILIATION
prompt: Review edits between a draft and approved weekly schedule: [versions, who changed what, timestamps, notifications]. Identify changed coverage, added hours, removed shifts, approval gaps and who must receive a corrected notice. Preserve the prior approved record.
manager_check: A saved edit is not the same as an approved published change.

title: EMPLOYEE SCHEDULE ACCESS AND PRIVACY
prompt: Evaluate an employee schedule-sharing process using QR or online access. Access model: [roles, link rules, device conditions]. Identify unauthorized visibility of wages, other employees' private information or stale schedules; recommend least-privilege access and employee confirmation steps.
manager_check: Employees need their schedule, not unrestricted access to private labor records.

title: CROSS-TRAINING COVERAGE OPPORTUNITY
prompt: Use verified training qualifications and next week's demand to identify safe cross-training opportunities. Employees and approved stations: [data]. Gaps: [days and shifts]. Distinguish development assignments from certified coverage and flag supervision requirements.
manager_check: Do not count an unqualified trainee as sole coverage for a safety-critical role.

title: WEEKLY DRAFT-TO-MANAGER APPROVAL PACK
prompt: Assemble a manager approval packet for a proposed schedule: [forecast, availability, draft, hour totals, conflicts, previous schedule]. Include key changes, policy checks, coverage risks, alternatives and sign-off fields. Clearly mark it as an unapproved proposal.
manager_check: Only designated managers may release an operational schedule.

title: FIRST INVENTORY 29-STEP READINESS GUIDE
prompt: Guide a manager through first Inventory Center setup using [restaurant profile, locations, item sources, initial counts]. Explain what must be entered before items, starting stock and daily changes can be trusted; provide a progress checklist and the next safe step without assuming steps were completed.
manager_check: Do not create stock balances until locations, units and source counts are verified.

title: RESTAURANT PROFILE FIRST-RUN SUPPORT
prompt: Help a new Inventory Center user when a profile window interrupts first-time guidance. Current screen: [description]. Saved data: [facts]. Offer safe navigation and data-preserving steps, explain profile fields and how to resume the guide. Escalate a reproducible lockup instead of telling a user to click repeatedly.
manager_check: Protect saved work and do not declare a frozen interface fixed with wording.

title: BARCODE SOURCE AND COLLISION CHECK
prompt: Review inventory barcode choices for [item list, vendor codes, internal labels and scanner model]. Distinguish supplier UPCs from customer-generated labels, detect duplicated barcodes and unit/pack mismatches, and outline a physical scan test before live use.
manager_check: A barcode identifies an item only when its mapping is correct.

title: LOCAL STORE PURCHASE RECEIVING
prompt: Build an auditable receiving record for supplies bought locally instead of from the primary vendor. Item master: [unit/pack]. Receipt: [store, date, pack, tax, price]. Record source and conversion without creating duplicate item identities; flag unusual one-off handling for review.
manager_check: Keep physical quantities and landed costs traceable across vendors.

title: INVENTORY BACKUP RESTORE DRILL
prompt: Plan a non-destructive inventory data backup and restoration test. Current version, backup source and location: [facts]. Define what records to preserve, how to verify integrity, test restore into a safe copy, and confirm counts and transactions before upgrading.
manager_check: A backup is only dependable after a safe restore verification.

title: COUNT POSTING AND CORRECTION TRACE
prompt: Check physical counts before they change on-hand stock. Item/location/period: [records]. Identify missing locations, negative or impossible balances, late receipts, duplicate posts and adjustments requiring approval. Build a correction trail that preserves the original count evidence.
manager_check: Never quietly overwrite a posted count to erase a variance.

title: REORDER PROPOSAL WITH LEAD-TIME RISK
prompt: Draft an inventory reorder proposal using verified stock, demand, safety quantity, case packs, vendor lead times and expected deliveries: [data]. Compare par-level alternatives, flag supply risks, shelf-life constraints and exceptional purchases, and require authorized purchasing approval.
manager_check: Suggested orders do not become purchase commitments automatically.
